info.title: Staff
info.description:
Create, read, or update basic staff information and signer configuration.

Staff are the people who work at an accounting firm and signers are staff that are [configured to sign tax returns]( https://z001download.cchaxcess.com/pfxbrowserhelp/FAMHelp/Content/TaxPlugIntoFAM/STF_StaffProfile_Tax.htm "view help article").

**_Note_**: Some staff of CCH Axcess are not users.

parameters.name: Integratorkey
parameters.description: integratorkey/subscription key in header

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: _Required_ when using [OAuth 2.0 token authentication](https://support.cch.com/kb/solution/000106115 "view support article") which is recommended for all firms. Firms using [Federation Services in CCH Axcess Login Options](https://z001download.cchaxcess.com/pfxbrowserhelp/FAMHelp/Content/ADPlugin/AD_FederationServices.htm "view help article") **must** use OAuth 2.0 and the Authorization header. The header value is "Bearer " followed by the JWT access token.

parameters.name: Security
parameters.description: _Required_ when using the token returned by [AzureAuthenticate](https://developers.cchaxcess.com/api-details#api=172e8059a9964ddd8614d530b1dafa7e&operation=Authenticates-the-user---Azure "view operation details") endpoint. This type of authentication is only compatible with firms using [CCH Axcess login method]( https://z001download.cchaxcess.com/pfxbrowserhelp/FAMHelp/Content/ADPlugin/AD_CCHLoginMode.htm "view help article"). While such firms **may** use the Security header, the Authorization header and [OAuth 2.0 token authentication](https://support.cch.com/kb/solution/000106115 "view support article") is recommended for all firms.
